pages.title: Pusheen Wearing a Santa Hat Beside Christmas Holly Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen wears a Santa hat beside Christmas holly in this printable coloring page, sitting upright with a small smile and rounded paws. The floppy hat, fluffy pompom, striped tail, pointed holly leaves, and round berries form bold, clearly separated shapes across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Dressed as Santa Claus Carrying a Sack of Christmas Presents Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen dresses as Santa Claus and carries a sack of Christmas presents in this printable coloring page, wearing a fluffy-trimmed coat and hat. Ribboned boxes rise from the sack, with striped wrapping, round spots, a wide belt buckle, and a small holly sprig adding details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Wearing Christmas Reindeer Antlers and a Jingle Bell Collar Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen wears Christmas reindeer antlers and a jingle bell collar in this printable coloring page, sitting upright with a small smile. The branching antlers, five round bells, forehead stripes, short whiskers, tiny paws, and striped tail leave clear outlined shapes across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Dressed as a Christmas Elf Sorting Toys in Santa's Workshop Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen dresses as a Christmas elf and sorts toys in Santa's workshop in this printable coloring page, holding a bow-tied teddy bear. A pointed hat and pompom collar sit above the worktable, surrounded by toy trains, a drum, rabbit, stacking rings, and shelf gifts on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Wearing a Christmas Sweater Patterned with Snowflakes and Pine Trees Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen wears a Christmas sweater patterned with snowflakes and pine trees in this printable coloring page, smiling beside a decorated tree. Ribbed borders and zigzag bands frame the sweater design, while baubles, bead garlands, a star topper, and a striped tail complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Dressed as a Decorated Christmas Tree with a Star on Top Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen dresses as a decorated Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, with a large star perched above the pointed ears. Scalloped branches, fluffy garlands, round baubles, and three ribbon bows cover the costume, while small paws and a striped tail peek out on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen as a Christmas Gingerbread Cat with Icing Decorations Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen appears as a Christmas gingerbread cat in this printable coloring page, with wavy icing bands and a bow across the round body. Two button shapes, a striped candy cane with a ribbon, and an iced tree cookie create bold festive details around the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Sitting Beside a Christmas Tree Decorated with Candy Canes Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen sits beside a Christmas tree decorated with candy canes in this printable coloring page, holding another striped cane between both paws. A star topper, bead garlands, round baubles, ribbon bows, and two wrapped presents surround the tree's broad scalloped branches on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen and Stormy Hanging Baubles on a Tabletop Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen and Stormy hang baubles on a tabletop Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, reaching toward its branches from opposite sides. Striped, dotted, and wavy ornaments hang below a star topper, while the small pot and scalloped tablecloth add simple shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Tangled in a String of Christmas Lights Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen gets tangled in a string of Christmas lights in this printable coloring page, gripping the wire between two rounded paws. The cord loops around the ears and body before curling across the ground, with large pointed bulbs and a striped tail completing the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Peeking Through a Christmas Wreath with a Large Bow Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen peeks through a Christmas wreath in this printable coloring page, resting both paws above a large ribbon bow. Holly leaves, berry clusters, striped baubles, and rounded foliage circle the cat's smiling face, leaving a mix of broad shapes and smaller details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Peeking Out of a Christmas Stocking Beside a Fireplace Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen peeks out of a Christmas stocking beside a fireplace in this printable coloring page, resting both paws on its fluffy cuff. Tree and dot patterns decorate the stocking below a bow, while holly, brickwork, flames, and two logs complete the festive coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unwrapping a Christmas Present Beneath the Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen unwraps a Christmas present beneath the tree in this printable coloring page, pulling torn paper away from a large rectangular box. Fir tree patterns cover the wrapping, with a bow-tied gift, round ornaments, bead garlands, and a star-topped tree behind the cat on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Hiding Inside an Open Christmas Gift Box with a Ribbon Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen hides inside an open Christmas gift box in this printable coloring page, resting both paws over the front edge. A large ribbon bow, broad wrapping bands, round spots, and folded box flaps surround the cat, with a raised striped tail completing the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen and Pip Exchanging Wrapped Christmas Presents Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen and Pip exchange wrapped Christmas presents in this printable coloring page, each holding a bow-tied box beneath a Santa hat. The larger and smaller cats sit beside a simple star-topped tree, with round ornaments, fluffy hat trim, and striped tails on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Wrapping a Christmas Present at a Low Table Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen wraps a Christmas present at a low table in this printable coloring page, folding paper patterned with little fir trees. A tape dispenser, scissors, loose ribbon, and wrapping roll lie around the box, while a small decorated tree stands behind the cat on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Looking at a Christmas Wish List Beside a Santa Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen looks at a Christmas wish list in this printable coloring page, holding a long illustrated scroll beneath a fluffy Santa hat. Pictures of a gift, gingerbread figure, and stocking run down the paper, with a plate of heart, star, and round cookies beside the coloring sheet's central cat.

pages.title: Pusheen Holding a Striped Christmas Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen holds a striped Christmas candy cane in this printable coloring page, gripping the oversized curved sweet between both front paws. Three forehead marks, short whiskers, side stripes, tiny feet, and a raised striped tail accompany the cat's broad rounded body on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Licking a Peppermint Christmas Lollipop Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen licks a peppermint Christmas lollipop in this printable coloring page, holding its stick in both paws beneath a Santa hat. Curving sections form the candy's pinwheel pattern, while a fluffy pompom, round eyes, forehead stripes, and curled tail add simple details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Eating a Gingerbread Man Cookie at Christmas Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen eats a gingerbread man cookie at Christmas in this printable coloring page, holding the bitten treat near a small smile. Icing cuffs, buttons, and a bow decorate the cookie, with a plate of more biscuits, a ribboned gift, and an ornamented tree on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Decorating a Christmas Gingerbread House with Candy Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen decorates a Christmas gingerbread house with candy in this printable coloring page, piping icing across the roof beneath a Santa hat. Candy-cane corners, heart details, round sweets, and shaped windows cover the little house, with a bowl of decorations and scattered candies on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Cutting Star-shaped Christmas Cookies From Dough Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen cuts star-shaped Christmas cookies from dough in this printable coloring page, pressing a large cutter with both paws. A Santa hat tops the smiling cat, while a rolling pin, star-patterned mixing bowl, dough scraps, and two finished cookie shapes fill the counter on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Icing a Christmas Tree Cookie at a Bakery Counter Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen ices a Christmas tree cookie at a bakery counter in this printable coloring page, guiding a piping bag across the large biscuit. Bow-tied garlands with stars and baubles hang above bowls of icing and candies, a tray, and a plate of decorated cookies on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Carrying a Tray of Christmas Cupcakes Topped with Holly Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen carries a tray of Christmas cupcakes topped with holly in this printable coloring page, balancing three treats between both paws. Swirled frosting, fluted wrappers, pointed leaves, and round berries add details in front of a simple decorated tree and two ribboned gifts on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Eating a Slice of Christmas Yule Log Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen eats a slice of Christmas Yule log cake in this printable coloring page, holding a plate beneath a fluffy Santa hat. A large spiral marks the cake's cut end, while bark-like lines, piped cream, holly leaves, and berries decorate the dessert on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Drinking Hot Chocolate with Marshmallows Beside Christmas Garland Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen drinks hot chocolate with marshmallows beside Christmas garland in this printable coloring page, holding a steaming tree-patterned mug over a striped scarf. Stars, baubles, holly, and a large bow hang above, with extra marshmallows, a snowflake cookie, a cushion, and a present below on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Sitting in a Mug Topped with Whipped Cream Beneath Christmas Lights Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen sits in a mug topped with whipped cream beneath Christmas lights in this printable coloring page, resting both paws on the creamy rim. Sprinkles, stars, a snowflake emblem, striped candy cane, gingerbread figure, and holly sprig surround the oversized cup on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Biting a Christmas Macaron Shaped Like a Pine Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen bites a Christmas macaron shaped like a pine tree in this printable coloring page, holding the layered treat between both paws. A star and wavy icing bands decorate the bitten dessert, while two holly sprigs, side stripes, and a striped tail complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen and Stormy Sharing a Christmas Pudding Topped with Holly Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen and Stormy share a Christmas pudding topped with holly in this printable coloring page, each holding a spoon beside the dessert. Dripping icing, round fruit shapes, pointed leaves, and three berries decorate the pudding, contrasting with the cats' smooth and fluffy outlines on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Eating a Festive Waffle in a Christmas Cafe Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen eats a festive waffle in a Christmas cafe in this printable coloring page, holding a cream-topped piece above a plate. Holly, a decorated mug, candy cane, wreath, bow-tied hanging lamp, and snowy window create a detailed cafe setting around the cat on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Leaving Cookies and Milk for Santa Beside the Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen leaves cookies and milk for Santa beside a Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, holding a star biscuit over the plate. A gingerbread figure, tree-shaped cookie, glass of milk, wrapped presents, bead garlands, bows, and ornaments surround the cat on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Curled Up Asleep Beneath a Decorated Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen curls up asleep beneath a decorated Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, resting closed eyes above two small front paws. Ribboned gifts flank the cat's cushion, while striped baubles, bead garlands, large bows, and a star topper fill the tree above on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Reading a Christmas Storybook Beside a Decorated Fireplace Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen reads a Christmas storybook beside a decorated fireplace in this printable coloring page, holding open pages illustrated with a tree and snowman. A checked cushion and oval rug sit below the cat, while stockings, garland, candles, holly, and a bow decorate the mantel on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Watching Snowfall Through a Window Framed By Christmas Lights Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen watches snowfall through a window framed by Christmas lights in this printable coloring page, sitting on a pompom cushion in a striped scarf. Snow-covered fir trees appear through the four panes, with a large bow, evergreen sprigs, hanging bulbs, and round snowflakes around the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Riding in Santa's Sleigh Above a Snowy Christmas Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen rides in Santa's sleigh above a snowy Christmas village in this printable coloring page, holding reins beneath a floppy hat. A reindeer pulls the gift-filled sleigh past clouds, stars, and a crescent moon, with snow-topped houses and fir trees below on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Sitting Beside Santa Claus and a Sack of Christmas Gifts Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen sits beside Santa Claus and a sack of Christmas gifts in this printable coloring page, resting under Santa's hand as he waves. His fluffy beard, moustache, coat trim, wide belt, and boots join ribboned boxes, a candy cane, and sack pompoms on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Building a Snowman Wearing a Santa Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen builds a snowman wearing a Santa hat in this printable coloring page, reaching toward the middle of its rounded body. A carrot nose, dotted smile, three buttons, twig arms, and a long fringed scarf decorate the snowman above simple mounds of snow on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Sledding Down a Snowy Hill Past Christmas Lights Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen sleds down a snowy hill past Christmas lights in this printable coloring page, gripping the front bar as a striped scarf streams behind. Curved runners, scattered snow, and motion lines emphasize the ride, with light-strung fir trees on the hills above the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Ice Skating Beside an Outdoor Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen ice skates beside an outdoor Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, gliding with one foot lifted and a fringed scarf around the neck. Curving skate marks cross the ice, while baubles, ribbon garlands, bows, a star topper, and snowbanks frame the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen and Stormy Having a Snowball Fight Beside a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen and Stormy have a snowball fight beside a Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, each holding a rounded ball of snow. Extra snowballs lie in two piles, with one flying between the cats beneath bead garlands, round baubles, and a star topper on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Making a Snow Angel While Wearing a Santa Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen makes a snow angel while wearing a Santa hat in this printable coloring page, lying on the back with all four paws visible. Curving impressions spread beside the body and feet, surrounded by small snow clumps, round flakes, a fluffy pompom, and a striped tail on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Wearing a Scarf and Earmuffs Beside a Snowy Christmas Pine Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen wears a scarf and earmuffs beside a snowy Christmas pine in this printable coloring page, sitting with a striped tail curved to one side. Fluffy ear pads, fringed scarf ends, simple snowbanks, round tree ornaments, and a large star create clear shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Sitting Inside a Christmas Snow Globe with a Tiny Decorated Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen sits inside a Christmas snow globe in this printable coloring page, holding a star beside a tiny decorated tree. Round snowflakes float within the glass dome, while a broad ribbon bow, scalloped trim, and dots decorate the sturdy globe base on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Carrying a Small Christmas Tree Home Through the Snow Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen carries a small Christmas tree home through the snow in this printable coloring page, holding its trunk beneath a striped scarf. A star topper and round baubles decorate the tree, with falling snow, footprints, rolling snowbanks, and larger fir trees around the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen and Stormy Singing Christmas Carols with an Open Songbook Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen and Stormy sing Christmas carols in this printable coloring page, sharing an open songbook beneath matching Santa hats. A tree and musical notes decorate the pages, while striped scarves, floating notes, an oval mat, and holly sprigs surround the two cats on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Holding a Christmas Greeting Card Beside a Decorated Mailbox Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen holds a Christmas greeting card beside a decorated mailbox in this printable coloring page, showing a star-topped tree between two hearts. A ribbon bow and holly trim the snowy mailbox, with its open door, raised flag, striped post, and rounded snowbanks completing the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Making a Paper Snowflake Garland at a Christmas Craft Table Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen makes a paper snowflake garland at a Christmas craft table in this printable coloring page, holding a cutout along the string. Scissors, a glue stick, stacked paper, loose geometric scraps, and another snowflake cover the table beside a small decorated tree on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Wearing a Paper Crown Beside an Opened Christmas Cracker Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen wears a paper crown beside an opened Christmas cracker in this printable coloring page, resting both paws on its two broken halves. Holly patterns and zigzag bands decorate the cracker, with another paper crown, a small ring, and scattered confetti below on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Celebrating Christmas with Stormy and Pip Beside a Decorated Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen celebrates Christmas with Stormy and Pip in this printable coloring page, gathering around three ribboned presents beneath a decorated tree. The cats' different sizes and fluffy outlines accompany patterned baubles, bead garlands, large bows, and a star topper across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen as a Christmas Snowman with a Santa Hat and Striped Scarf Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen appears as a Christmas snowman in this printable coloring page, wearing a Santa hat and a long striped scarf. Two oversized buttons with four holes decorate the round body, while small paws, forehead stripes, a striped tail, and simple snowbanks complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Christmas in Halloween Neighborhood Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen celebrates Christmas in a Halloween neighborhood in this printable coloring page, holding a candy cane and a pumpkin bucket beneath festive headwear. A striped scarf, jack-o'-lanterns, spiderweb windows, bats, a wreath, bare branches, stars, and a crescent moon fill the mixed-holiday coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Christmas in Space Station Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen celebrates Christmas in a space station in this printable coloring page, wearing a Santa hat and scarf behind curved control panels. Earth and a tiny rocket appear through the round window, with a floating gift, decorated tree, stocking, planets, and starry screens around the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Christmas on Alien Planet Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen celebrates Christmas on an alien planet in this printable coloring page, wearing a Santa hat and a star-patterned sweater. Planet ornaments decorate the nearby tree, while ribboned presents, rocky ground, pointed formations, ringed worlds, stars, and a crescent moon create the setting on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Christmas in Playroom Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen celebrates Christmas in a playroom in this printable coloring page, holding a candy cane beneath a Santa hat and little bow collar. A rocking horse, teddy bear, toy train, block, framed stocking picture, decorated tree, and ribboned gifts surround the striped rug on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Christmas in Boba Tea Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen celebrates Christmas in a boba tea shop in this printable coloring page, holding a large decorated drink while seated on a stool. A ribboned straw, round pearls, candy-cane cup designs, hanging lights, snowflakes, menu board, register, and festive counter fill the coloring sheet.
